title: unitShots
responsibility: Reads pinned verified Git captures through root history services without Desktop runtime imports or generated application configuration.

inputs.name: unitShots.root
inputs.description: Directory passed unchanged as the first argument to GitAdapter, HistoryStatusService and RevisionDetailService, which run the ref listing and the revision reads against it. This function makes no check of the directory itself.

inputs.name: unitShots.entity
inputs.description: The unit id passed unchanged as { id: entity } to explorerEvidence, which uses it to select the scenarios and captures that cover this unit at the commit. This function does no lookup or normalization, so a unit that no scenario covers gets the gap explorerEvidence reports for that case, such as 'No scenario covers this unit at this commit.' when a record is present.

inputs.name: unitShots.commit
inputs.description: The source commit passed unchanged to RevisionDetailService.build and to explorerEvidence as the scope commit. explorerEvidence refuses any revision whose commit differs from this value and returns a gap saying that revision is not available, and this function does no format check of the value itself.

outputs.name: unitShots
outputs.description: The resolved UnitShots: its captures field lists every capture explorerEvidence selects for the unit on the commit's side, each with its usable flag, and its gap field is null exactly when at least one of those captures is usable. When notesRef or evidenceRef is absent from the ref listing, it resolves to captures [] and the fixed gap 'No attached Harness verification evidence at this revision.' without calling HistoryStatusService or RevisionDetailService.

examples.gap: No attached Harness verification evidence at this revision.
The record of this commit holds no capture for this unit.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: This function has no try/catch, so errors thrown or rejected by the GitAdapter, HistoryStatusService, RevisionDetailService or explorerEvidence calls reach the caller as a rejection of the returned promise, unchanged. No fallback value replaces them, and missing notesRef or evidenceRef is a normal return, not an error.
